newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Carter Holt reshuffles NZ execs with IP.
newsitem.headline: Carter Holt reshuffles NZ execs with IP.

text.p: Carter Holt Harvey Ltd, just over half owned by International Paper, said on Friday it would rejig its senior management team in New Zealand after the departure of George O'Brien to return to IP's paper operations in the United States.
O'Brien is current chief executive of CHH's pulp, paper and tissue businesses.
In a statement CHH said pulp and paper profit responsibility would be taken over by Kent Blumberg, currently general manager of operations for those sectors.
Doug McKay, current packaging chief executive, will assume additional responsibility for tissue.
Both men will report to the company's chief executive officer John Faraci at the company's Auckland headquarters.
